provisional_canonical_claim: Let M be an o-minimal expansion of a dense linear order. For every natural n and every finite family of definable subsets of M^n, there is a finite cylindrical cell decomposition of M^n compatible with every set in the family.
domain_and_universes: Provisionally, a first-order language L expanding a dense linear order on a nonempty carrier M, with source-exact parameter convention; arity n; and a finite family of definable subsets of M^n. The language-map, universe, tuple representation, cell recursion, and parameter encoding remain open.
ordered_quantifiers: ordered language expansion L and carrier M
compatible L-structure and dense linear order
finite family A of definable subsets of M^n
hypotheses: the L-structure expands the relevant dense linear order, with endpoint assumptions fixed from the source
every unary definable set satisfies the source's o-minimal finite points-and-intervals condition
every member of A is definable under exactly the selected parameter convention
conclusion: Provisionally, a finite cylindrical partition of M^n into recursively defined cells such that each input set is a union of cells.

alternate_encodings.target: a finite cell family that partitions M^n and is compatible with each input set
alternate_encodings.relationship: intended set-family form; exact equivalence to a recursive decomposition object requires checked transport

alternate_encodings.target: a decomposition on which finitely many definable functions are continuous or prepared
alternate_encodings.relationship: possible stronger or companion source variant, not interchangeable until the source theorem is selected

degenerate_cases_open: The statement phase must decide n = 0, an empty input family, empty cells, repeated sets, bounded and unbounded interval cells, graphs versus strips, endpoint functions taking infinities, and parameters. No convention is silently fixed.
